decisions: 2026-10-15: user confirmed Metaso added 30-second generation and authorized conversion using the pinned Yingce protocol source

2026-10-15 historical scope: kept usage fields and prices; reference usage naming and validation superseded by ADR-0130 on 2026-11-05
profiles.json is the conservative host integration declaration: image references only; video/audio references and additional billing configuration are not automatically enabled
No verified upstream model-list endpoint; modelDiscovery is intentionally absent

2026-11-05: ADR-0130 sections 4/5 (implementation adjustment) and t3-new-api-gate sections 2a/4 authorize plugin-only video_durations validation and reference_video_duration_seconds facts for the sole declared model MiniMax-H3; no mediaMetadata host dependency

Reference durations use the existing host second-unit ceiling of 3600 per entry and total; the prior plugin had no reference-duration ceiling. The output duration limit remains 30. This is a billing safety bound, not a verified vendor reference-media limit

Explicit duplicate video positions are retained; cross-alias deduplication, shadowed legacy video content and uploads across multiple video file fields are rejected when positional matching is ambiguous

Reference seconds never enter billing_ratios or supplier request bodies. Completion input_seconds must be a finite nonnegative number, including zero; missing or invalid reports omit the fact and preserve frozen submission usage
Candidate only: keep official installed snapshot and profiles.json unchanged. Prices and activation require separate authorization
